b9dcbac14e78e16dbc05.en: Two Rp500 coins make Rp1.000. One Rp200 coin makes Rp1.200. Three Rp100 coins make Rp300 more. In all, there is Rp1.500.
b9dcbac14e78e16dbc05.id: Dua koin Rp500 menjadi Rp1.000. Satu koin Rp200 membuatnya menjadi Rp1.200. Tiga koin Rp100 menambah Rp300 lagi. Semuanya ada Rp1.500.

09428f9f0a234c1c3d45.id: Satu koin Rp200 membuatnya menjadi Rp1.200.

3d55d2b255a4592a8b67.en: Three Rp100 coins make Rp300 more.
3d55d2b255a4592a8b67.id: Tiga koin Rp100 menambah Rp300 lagi.

cd88ce2375cc859f5123.en: Dewi pays Rp5.000 and the book costs Rp3.500. Her change is 5.000 - 3.500 = Rp1.500.
cd88ce2375cc859f5123.id: Dewi membayar Rp5.000 dan harga buku itu Rp3.500. Kembaliannya 5.000 - 3.500 = Rp1.500.

07885c73d33627cc6e4f.en: Dewi pays Rp5.000 and the book costs Rp3.500.
07885c73d33627cc6e4f.id: Dewi membayar Rp5.000 dan harga buku itu Rp3.500.

ae2c9da0f98b97591eb1.en: Take a Rp1.000 coin. Rp700 is left. Take a Rp500 coin. Rp200 is left. Take a Rp200 coin. That is 3 coins.
ae2c9da0f98b97591eb1.id: Ambil koin Rp1.000. Sisanya Rp700. Ambil koin Rp500. Sisanya Rp200. Ambil koin Rp200. Itu 3 koin.

514201c66de3328d5413.en: With no Rp200 coin: 5 coins of Rp100. With one Rp200 coin: 3 coins of Rp100. With two Rp200 coins: 1 coin of Rp100. Three Rp200 coins are too much. So there are 3 ways.
514201c66de3328d5413.id: Tanpa koin Rp200: 5 koin Rp100. Dengan satu koin Rp200: 3 koin Rp100. Dengan dua koin Rp200: 1 koin Rp100. Tiga koin Rp200 terlalu banyak. Jadi, ada 3 cara.

c601a9a3a6d0f48cfd65.en: With no Rp200 coin: 5 coins of Rp100.

4dcfa8531f76e2e0bfae.en: With one Rp200 coin: 3 coins of Rp100.
4dcfa8531f76e2e0bfae.id: Dengan satu koin Rp200: 3 koin Rp100.

b86ed49819ee3c3e4936.en: With two Rp200 coins: 1 coin of Rp100.
b86ed49819ee3c3e4936.id: Dengan dua koin Rp200: 1 koin Rp100.

14e64ea72b623facbd7a.en: Three Rp200 coins are too much.

9389a811217673fb6799.en: Rp500 + Rp100 + Rp100 = Rp700. The other choices make Rp600, Rp900, Rp500 and Rp1.100.
9389a811217673fb6799.id: Rp500 + Rp100 + Rp100 = Rp700. Pilihan lainnya menjadi Rp600, Rp900, Rp500, dan Rp1.100.

668093f7c4995e93a5af.en: The other choices make Rp600, Rp900, Rp500 and Rp1.100.
668093f7c4995e93a5af.id: Pilihan lainnya menjadi Rp600, Rp900, Rp500, dan Rp1.100.

bfbcecb1c2d591fb98e4.en: Three pencils cost Rp1.500 + Rp1.500 + Rp1.500 = Rp4.500.
bfbcecb1c2d591fb98e4.id: Tiga pensil harganya Rp1.500 + Rp1.500 + Rp1.500 = Rp4.500.

b921a5d0a08a417df4bb.en: Two toys cost Rp6.000. With the ball she spends Rp8.500. She has Rp10.000 - Rp8.500 = Rp1.500 left.
b921a5d0a08a417df4bb.id: Dua mainan harganya Rp6.000. Dengan bola, belanjanya menjadi Rp8.500. Uangnya tersisa Rp10.000 - Rp8.500 = Rp1.500.

9e2b5680b801fddff8eb.en: With the ball she spends Rp8.500.

0b33a8bb3d2f8a4de971.en: She has Rp10.000 - Rp8.500 = Rp1.500 left.

70997c9526edae951028.en: Take away Tono's extra Rp2.000. Rp6.000 is left. Share it equally: each boy has Rp3.000. So Adi has Rp3.000 and Tono has Rp5.000.
70997c9526edae951028.id: Ambil dulu kelebihan Rp2.000 milik Tono. Sisanya Rp6.000. Bagi sama rata: setiap anak mendapat Rp3.000. Jadi, Adi punya Rp3.000 dan Tono punya Rp5.000.

b22c351ee947216249cf.en: Adi has Rp3.000 and Tono has Rp5.000.
b22c351ee947216249cf.id: Adi punya Rp3.000 dan Tono punya Rp5.000.

3bbfc4d562bfd6ef2635.en: Mia needs Rp7.000 - Rp4.500 = Rp2.500 more.
3bbfc4d562bfd6ef2635.id: Mia perlu Rp7.000 - Rp4.500 = Rp2.500 lagi.

3cd04e59469b88d24d50.en: Two Rp500 coins, five Rp200 coins, one Rp1.000 coin and Rp500 + Rp200 + Rp200 + Rp100 are all Rp1.000. Rp500 + Rp200 + Rp100 + Rp100 is only Rp900.
3cd04e59469b88d24d50.id: Dua koin Rp500, lima koin Rp200, satu koin Rp1.000, dan Rp500 + Rp200 + Rp200 + Rp100 semuanya Rp1.000. Rp500 + Rp200 + Rp100 + Rp100 hanya Rp900.

5b54a00f2f25092d0224.en: Two Rp500 coins, five Rp200 coins, one Rp1.000 coin and Rp500 + Rp200 + Rp200 + Rp100 are all Rp1.000.
5b54a00f2f25092d0224.id: Dua koin Rp500, lima koin Rp200, satu koin Rp1.000, dan Rp500 + Rp200 + Rp200 + Rp100 semuanya Rp1.000.

cf4b9324c2261c6a8c13.en: Rp500 + Rp200 + Rp100 + Rp100 is only Rp900.
cf4b9324c2261c6a8c13.id: Rp500 + Rp200 + Rp100 + Rp100 hanya Rp900.

cdc872c97e90a25b3f60.en: Four apples cost Rp4.000. Five apples cost Rp5.000, which is more than Rp4.500. So Mia can buy 4 apples.
cdc872c97e90a25b3f60.id: Empat apel harganya Rp4.000. Lima apel harganya Rp5.000, dan itu lebih dari Rp4.500. Jadi, Mia bisa membeli 4 apel.

758d959b3c9622e3de5c.en: Five apples cost Rp5.000, which is more than Rp4.500.
758d959b3c9622e3de5c.id: Lima apel harganya Rp5.000, dan itu lebih dari Rp4.500.

596902ae6cafcc7af8ba.en: The juice and the bun cost Rp2.500 + Rp1.500 = Rp4.000. Ben has Rp5.000 - Rp4.000 = Rp1.000 left. That is exactly the price of the sweet, so he can buy it.
596902ae6cafcc7af8ba.id: Jus dan roti harganya Rp2.500 + Rp1.500 = Rp4.000. Uang Ben tersisa Rp5.000 - Rp4.000 = Rp1.000. Itu tepat sama dengan harga permen, jadi dia bisa membelinya.

493626704e45f9513834.en: The juice and the bun cost Rp2.500 + Rp1.500 = Rp4.000.
493626704e45f9513834.id: Jus dan roti harganya Rp2.500 + Rp1.500 = Rp4.000.

c88f76e0134bedfa9828.en: Ben has Rp5.000 - Rp4.000 = Rp1.000 left.
c88f76e0134bedfa9828.id: Uang Ben tersisa Rp5.000 - Rp4.000 = Rp1.000.

ada3186a22d409b74eeb.en: That is exactly the price of the sweet, so he can buy it.
ada3186a22d409b74eeb.id: Itu tepat sama dengan harga permen, jadi dia bisa membelinya.

d15e97842522786539d1.en: Three Rp500 coins are Rp1.500. Two Rp2.000 notes are Rp4.000. She has Rp5.500. She needs Rp8.000 - Rp5.500 = Rp2.500 more.
d15e97842522786539d1.id: Tiga koin Rp500 adalah Rp1.500. Dua uang kertas Rp2.000 adalah Rp4.000. Dia punya Rp5.500. Dia perlu Rp8.000 - Rp5.500 = Rp2.500 lagi.

011acf287e2ebc9e84ad.id: Dua uang kertas Rp2.000 adalah Rp4.000.

c44eb2856b309b041551.en: She needs Rp8.000 - Rp5.500 = Rp2.500 more.
c44eb2856b309b041551.id: Dia perlu Rp8.000 - Rp5.500 = Rp2.500 lagi.

71f48c0a89150b914e20.en: Dina spent Rp10.000 - Rp2.000 = Rp8.000 on 2 books. One book costs Rp8.000 / 2 = Rp4.000.
71f48c0a89150b914e20.id: Dina memakai Rp10.000 - Rp2.000 = Rp8.000 untuk 2 buku. Satu buku harganya Rp8.000 / 2 = Rp4.000.

e08182d8884212b14c54.en: Dina spent Rp10.000 - Rp2.000 = Rp8.000 on 2 books.
e08182d8884212b14c54.id: Dina memakai Rp10.000 - Rp2.000 = Rp8.000 untuk 2 buku.

993811640ba4fd059c4d.en: Two Rp500 coins make Rp1.000. Rp5.000 has 5 groups of Rp1.000. So 5 × 2 = 10 coins.
993811640ba4fd059c4d.id: Dua koin Rp500 menjadi Rp1.000. Rp5.000 berisi 5 kelompok Rp1.000. Jadi, 5 × 2 = 10 koin.

d58d116b0c02b7f22fd3.en: Mia has 4 x Rp500 = Rp2.000. Sam has 5 x Rp200 = Rp1.000. Mia has Rp1.000 more.
d58d116b0c02b7f22fd3.id: Mia punya 4 x Rp500 = Rp2.000. Sam punya 5 x Rp200 = Rp1.000. Mia punya Rp1.000 lebih banyak.

e3daf0ee545a9f915bc8.en: Five coins of Rp200 are worth Rp1.000. Rp1.600 is Rp600 more. Each swap of a Rp200 coin for a Rp500 coin adds Rp300. So Mia swapped 600 / 300 = 2 coins. She has 2 coins of Rp500.
e3daf0ee545a9f915bc8.id: Lima koin Rp200 bernilai Rp1.000. Rp1.600 adalah Rp600 lebih banyak. Setiap kali menukar koin Rp200 dengan koin Rp500, nilainya bertambah Rp300. Jadi, Mia menukar 600 / 300 = 2 koin. Dia punya 2 koin Rp500.

82be8ff5fa1b12951a42.en: Five coins of Rp200 are worth Rp1.000.

d84e5760df5bfd04a5f5.en: Each swap of a Rp200 coin for a Rp500 coin adds Rp300.
d84e5760df5bfd04a5f5.id: Setiap kali menukar koin Rp200 dengan koin Rp500, nilainya bertambah Rp300.

2b3565e835fef362212d.en: One coin makes 100, 200 or 500. Two coins make 300, 600 or 700. All 3 coins make 800. All 7 amounts are different, so there are 7.
2b3565e835fef362212d.id: Satu koin menghasilkan 100, 200, atau 500. Dua koin menghasilkan 300, 600, atau 700. Semua 3 koin menghasilkan 800. Semua 7 jumlah itu berbeda, jadi ada 7.

047540888d767b1e18e7.en: All 7 amounts are different, so there are 7.
047540888d767b1e18e7.id: Semua 7 jumlah itu berbeda, jadi ada 7.

2c6ac72b642f8dfc8686.en: The other note is Rp7.000 - Rp2.000 = Rp5.000.
2c6ac72b642f8dfc8686.id: Uang kertas yang satu lagi Rp7.000 - Rp2.000 = Rp5.000.

761317aca6a3a79e3c74.en: Take away the extra Rp1.000 and Rp2.000 is left. Share it between the two things: the ruler costs Rp1.000. The pen costs Rp1.000 more, so it costs Rp2.000.
761317aca6a3a79e3c74.id: Ambil dulu kelebihan Rp1.000, lalu sisanya Rp2.000. Bagi untuk kedua benda itu: harga penggaris Rp1.000. Harga pena Rp1.000 lebih mahal, jadi harganya Rp2.000.

49c284c2c7ed076a2a08.en: Take away the extra Rp1.000 and Rp2.000 is left.
49c284c2c7ed076a2a08.id: Ambil dulu kelebihan Rp1.000, lalu sisanya Rp2.000.

b5d37c44783c034e0a9f.en: Share it between the two things: the ruler costs Rp1.000.
b5d37c44783c034e0a9f.id: Bagi untuk kedua benda itu: harga penggaris Rp1.000.

7a30ce460aaefdf7d794.en: The pen costs Rp1.000 more, so it costs Rp2.000.
7a30ce460aaefdf7d794.id: Harga pena Rp1.000 lebih mahal, jadi harganya Rp2.000.

f29bd3e7eaf2609c8925.en: Two Rp2.000 notes make Rp4.000. With the Rp5.000 note she has Rp9.000. She needs Rp9.500 - Rp9.000 = Rp500 more.
f29bd3e7eaf2609c8925.id: Dua uang kertas Rp2.000 menjadi Rp4.000. Dengan uang kertas Rp5.000, dia punya Rp9.000. Dia perlu Rp9.500 - Rp9.000 = Rp500 lagi.

266ff677f4c9c58371af.en: With the Rp5.000 note she has Rp9.000.
266ff677f4c9c58371af.id: Dengan uang kertas Rp5.000, dia punya Rp9.000.

93b4622f404fccb4c4cb.en: She needs Rp9.500 - Rp9.000 = Rp500 more.
93b4622f404fccb4c4cb.id: Dia perlu Rp9.500 - Rp9.000 = Rp500 lagi.
